title: Descriptor heap mini-allocator for CBV/SRV/UAV
motivation: Replace hardcoded descriptor indices with a tiny allocator to avoid collisions and simplify future resource growth (HDR, volume, TLAS, samplers).
deliverables: A fixed-size descriptor heap wrapper with allocate/free and CPU/GPU handle getters
Integration in App: allocate slots for HDR SRV/UAV and future resources
Bounds checks and logging for allocations
acceptance: App runs as before; descriptors are allocated via the wrapper
No index collisions; logging shows allocated indices
PIX shows correct heap bound for composite and DXR
implementation: Create a CBV_SRV_UAV heap with N descriptors (e.g., 64)
Simple free-list or bump allocator with optional free()
Migrate HDR SRV/UAV creation to request indices from the allocator
test_plan: Allocate >2 descriptors, run, and confirm handles change accordingly
Stress with recreateHDRTexture() to ensure no leaks
